owners.runtime: Immutable planning revisions, decisions, Roadmap baseline and execution binding
owners.ontology: Business semantics and independently reviewed native asset candidates
owners.harness: Quality and acceptance rules and independently reviewed native candidates
owners.expert: Project-scoped dialogue, source capture and guidance; no independent authority

sourcePolicy: Capture only scoped available excerpts, summaries or references. Preserve their distinct evidence categories and do not assert unavailable original conversations. No automatic global chat access.
storage: Private project planning data and Runtime protected records in user Workspace; product source contains only generic contracts/templates/examples. Repository Roadmap can be an explicitly exported, digest-bound view.
statePolicy: New revisions are DRAFT. Exact human evidence confirms APPROVED/REJECTED. New drafts and approvals preserve all prior revisions. Binding and actual execution approval are separate.
compatibility: Add Runtime planning API and schema 6 read protection; retain historical records and native specifications/v1 byte-for-byte. Existing projects without planning bindings stay readable/executable under their existing reviewed contracts. Expert guides new planning work through the standard entry.
